system.description:
You spin your weapon in front of you while coated in your chakra creating a spinning shield. Roll your [Weapons Damage] + 2d6, reducing the triggering damage by the result.

You can then lash out, retaliating against the offending target. Make a ranged Taijutsu attack against the triggering creature if they are within your weapons range. On a hit, you deal [Weapons Damage] + 2d6. Make an additional attack targeting the same creature if you are in Chain rank 2 or 3.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and reduce damage you take and increase the damage you deal retaliating by an additional 1d6.
